claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the mandatory stopping, listening, and looking duty and distance boundaries before crossing railroad tracks at grade, preserving the paragraph (b) exception and vehicle scope references.
The claim correctly reflects the permission to drive across the tracks when safe in a gear that completes the crossing without changing gears.
The claim accurately states the prohibition against shifting gears while crossing the railroad tracks.
The claim correctly identifies every bus transporting passengers as one of the specified commercial motor vehicles subject to the rule.
The claim accurately specifies vehicles transporting any quantity of Division 2.3 chlorine as subject to paragraph (a).
The claim faithfully enumerates the complete list of DOT marking and placarding classifications specified in paragraph (a)(3).
The claim correctly states the category covering cargo tank motor vehicles (loaded or empty) used for transporting hazardous materials under 49 CFR parts 107 through 180.
The claim accurately captures the scope of cargo tank motor vehicles transporting commodities loaded above flashpoint pursuant to 49 CFR 173.120.
The claim accurately represents cargo tank motor vehicles (loaded or empty) transporting commodities under exemption per 49 CFR part 107 subpart B.
The claim correctly details the exemption from stopping at streetcar crossings or industrial switching tracks within a business district defined in 49 CFR 390.5.
The claim accurately reflects the exemption where a police officer or crossing flagman directs traffic to proceed.
The claim accurately states the exemption for grade crossings controlled by an active green traffic signal permitting transit without stopping or slowing under local law.
The claim accurately captures the stopping exemption for marked abandoned railroad grade crossings.
The claim correctly reflects the stopping exemption for industrial or spur line crossings marked 'Exempt'.
The claim accurately reflects the requirement that 'Exempt' signs may only be erected by or with the consent of the appropriate State or local authority.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 completely and accurately captures the stopping distance, checking procedure, and negative duty established in 49 CFR 392.10(a).
Claim C0001 preserves the conditional permission to proceed across the tracks in an appropriate gear when safe to do so.

Claim C0003 covers the vehicle scope category in paragraph (a)(1) regarding buses transporting passengers.
Claim C0004 preserves the vehicle scope category in paragraph (a)(2) regarding Division 2.3 chlorine transport.
Claim C0005 completely covers the placarded and marked vehicle categories specified in paragraph (a)(3).
Claim C0006 preserves the hazardous material cargo tank scope specified in paragraph (a)(4).
Claim C0007 captures the cargo tank scope for commodities loaded above flashpoint under paragraph (a)(5).
Claim C0008 covers cargo tank motor vehicles transporting under exemption pursuant to paragraph (a)(6).
Claim C0009 covers the stopping exemption for streetcar crossings and industrial switching tracks in business districts.
Claim C0010 covers the exemption when a police officer or crossing flagman directs traffic to proceed.
Claim C0011 preserves the exemption for crossings controlled by a green highway traffic signal.
Claim C0012 covers the exemption for marked abandoned railroad grade crossings.
Claim C0013 preserves the stopping exemption for industrial or spur line crossings marked 'Exempt'.
Claim C0014 preserves the legal authority requirement governing the erection of 'Exempt' signs.
